setup.title: Connect Dana
setup.body: Put your Dana server's address and an API token in %1, one per line. The window picks them up as soon as the file is saved.
setup.badUrl: DANA_URL in %1 must be an https address with no path, like https://dana.example.com.
setup.badToken: DANA_TOKEN in %1 is missing or doesn't look like a token.
error.auth: The server refused the token. Check DANA_TOKEN.

error.http: The server answered with an error.
